This is a great foaming cleanser for removing makeup and leaving the skin feeling super fresh and clean. I love that you can use this both to remove makeup and as a morning facial cleanser. It did leave my skin a little tight after and in need of some moisture, but the positive is that it does remove literally every trace of makeup and my skin was left feeling super smooth. Just need a good moisturizer and a toner to follow up after! There is also a pretty strong scent, almost minty, and it could be an issue for super sensitive skin. I do have sensitive skin and did not notice any breakouts or issues from using this. Overall, I will use this as a makeup remover before following up with my regular cleanser and skincare routine, and toss in my travel bag for an effective makeup remover on the go. I received this product for free from MAC Cosmetics for testing and review purposes.

I love this cleanser! I've gotten into jelly cleansers in the last year, and this one has replaced Innsfree as my favorite! I love how the soft lather removes my makeup and leaves my skin feel clean and soft. I love how gentle and non-drying it is. 10/10 recommend! "I received this product for free from MAC Cosmetics for testing and review purposes."
I received this product for testing and reviewing purposes from Mac cosmetics and I used it before bed & it works wondering smells good and really cleans & leaves your face feeling refreshed

I tried the Mac cosmetics FOAMO gel cleanser, and had an allergic reaction. My skin is typically not sensitive at all, so I was surprised to see my skin after using this cleanser. My face felt amazing while removing makeup and cleansing. I felt an awesome "cooling" sensation that felt amazing while cleansing, until my face started turning beat red and burning. It really surprised me as I usually don't react to much when it comes to what I put on my face. I like the texture of the cleanser and the packaging, but I'm afraid to use it again due to the reaction I got from trying it. I really wish it didn't cause a reaction as I like everything else about the product. It removes makeup extremely well along with dirt and oil. I just can't handle the aftermath. I still love you Mac cosmetics! "I received this from Mac cosmetics in exchange for my honest review"

I received this product for free from MAC Cosmetics for testing and review purposes. I used this in the morning with no makeup on in the shower, the first thing I noticed was that it had a lemony smell which I didn't mind. I used a small amount of it and I could tell right away that it would last very long! A little amount was good enough to cover my face and neck, it also foamed up very well. After, I noticed that my skin felt clean and my pores were slightly smaller/less visible. I like it so far and I will continue to use!

avis.titre: A Cloud-Like Clean You'll Actually Look Forward To
avis.texte: I received this product for free from MAC Cosmetics for testing and review purposes. But from the very first pump, MAC's new foam cleanser impressed me with its airy, cloud-like texture. It expands beautifully in the hands and instantly makes cleansing feel more luxurious and enjoyable. Despite being lightweight, it provides a thorough clean that never leaves my skin feeling tight or stripped. After using it consistently, I noticed my skin looking brighter and more refreshed. It helped clear out areas that usually get congested for me, and the soft, subtle scent added a calming touch to my routine. I love that it rinses off effortlessly and works perfectly in both my morning and nighttime skincare rituals. Overall, this cleanser genuinely earned a permanent spot on my top shelf. It blends performance, gentle cleansing, and a luxe sensorial experience, all things I look for in a product I reach for daily. MAC truly delivered with this launch, and I'm excited to keep it in my routine moving forward.

I'm in love , It's the best cleanser I've ever tried. You don't need to spend time removing your makeup because this cleanser does it all for you. It cleans all the impurities from your face and leaves your skin very soft and firm, and the scent is delicious. You'll love it as much as I do. Thank you so much for this magnificent creation! , the best cleanser ever

I use this product after a long day of wearing makeup for over eight hours, and it melted my make up right off. I didn't have to scrub my face after afterwards, trying to get any additional makeup off that was left on my skin, it worked like magic will be recommend recommending to anyone that asked me how I get my makeup off my face. over all pretty good. pretty viscous so it requires multiple rinses. nice cap to have control over dispensing. good for taking off makeup and cleaning dirty oily skin. has a tingling sensation on the skin.

I received this product in exchange for my honest review. Right away, I noticed that this MAC major foamo jelly cleanser smells great! It smells very clean. This jelly is lighter than you'd think it would be, it goes onto my skin very smooth and feels great when applying. It's Not harsh on my skin at all and I can tell that it really gets the job done. This jelly cleanser works great if you have combination skin, I do wish that it would have moisturized it a bit better but it did not dry out my skin like other cleansers! It also states that it does not clog pores, and it didn't clog mine! My skin can be sensitive when it comes to acne and I had no issues using this product!
